api.configure(problem,editable,policy,parse_: Build appropriate structured widget; parse_callable is shared bounded engine parser, no duplicate parser or solver
api.restore(state): Restore identical question widget state without regenerating questions
api.answer(): Structured engine-compatible answer; no grading locally
api.answer_codec.decode(text,question_id): bounded JSON envelope <=65536 UTF8 bytes, exact question/version, whitelist state keys; called only AFTER host peer/assessment/deadline ownership guards; returns separate answer/state
api.paper_adapter.mount(...): mount workspace and save callback(question_id,structured_answer,state_json); existing ink/paper remains integrator-owned
api.demonstration_parameters_changed(paramet: Generic teaching controls (e.g. R/C/time constant) emit values to host provider; provider recomputes descriptor. No UI physical solver.
api.math_paper_page: Drop-in control compatible with paper_ui and school_world; overview + one question/page + marked page; keeps existing paper_ink. Source patch separate.
api.demonstration_changed(data): Read-only whiteboard teaching interactions emit updated coordinate/geometry/table descriptors for host synchronization. They do not submit test answers.

ast: MTH147.engine.v1 input_ast; num/symbol/add/sub/mul/div/pow/neg/functions; UI-only matrix/determinant/subscript/complex_polar/equation display nodes. Parser supplied by engine. Unsupported nodes fail visibly.

answers.scalar: text, or engine AST when parse succeeds
answers.nested_fields: input.fields entries with kind solutions/multiple/restrictions serialize arrays

graph.curves: array of same functions with label/color
graph.angle_unit: degrees|radians; phase has x-axis units; period controls full cycle independent of display angle unit
graph.samples: Public inference curves may be {kind:samples,label,points:[{x,y}]} <=2048; renders only sampled coordinates without host function parameters
graph.student_points: Editable graphs initialize student points empty. Diagram/reference points are never submitted as student answers. Provider must strip private required points/functions as appropriate.
graph.phasors: optional [{magnitude,angle,angle_unit}] derived by authoritative teaching provider; display only

persistence.drawing: opaque existing ink state; never auto-graded

whiteboard mounts read-only descriptor/rendered AST and staged steps
calculator remains integrator-owned; toolbar provides notation only, no solver
dashboard uses existing course result APIs; UI never mutates grades/rewards
